settings.question: What is a preorder?
settings.answer: You reserve your shirt during a short preorder window. When the window closes we print the whole run, then ship. It lets a small brand make exactly what people want instead of guessing.

settings.question: When will my shirt ship?
settings.answer: The exact ship window is shown on the product page and in your order confirmation. We'll post it before preorders open, once our printer confirms it.

settings.question: Can I cancel?
settings.answer: Yes. Cancel any time before printing starts for a full refund. Once printing starts, the order is final because each shirt is made for you, though defects are always covered.

settings.question: How does it fit?
settings.answer: Oversized and boxy with dropped shoulders. See the size guide.

settings.question: How heavy is the shirt?
settings.answer: Heavyweight cotton. We're confirming the exact blank and weight with samples and will list it on the product page before preorders open.

settings.question: Is the artwork exactly what I'll get?
settings.answer: The images are concept artwork. The printed shirt follows the same design. We'll post real photos of samples before preorders open.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Drop 001 ships within the US. If you're outside the US, join the waitlist and tell us where.
